items.title: Where CVX's $119 billion Of Shareholder Cash Came From
items.summary: A torrent of cash returned to Chevron owners has powered market-beating returns, but it raises a sharp question about where the energy giant goes from here.

items.title: Energy Expert Warns Venezuela’s 65 Billion-Barrel Oil Deal Won’t Fix Supply Anytime Soon
items.summary: Venezuela sits on a staggering share of the world's proven oil reserves, and a new U.S. deal just handed American companies a major stake in them. But one energy expert says investors may be wildly misjudging when any of that oil actually reaches the market.

items.title: Trump's Venezuela Deal Leaves $100 Billion Question Unanswered
items.summary: President Trump is framing the deal for a US stake in 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil as a victory that will lower gasoline prices and replenish depleted crude reserves. It's far from certain the plan will lead to either during his presidency if at all. Trump pushed for a blockbuster move after growing frustrated that private oil companies, including ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. and ConocoPhillips, weren't moving quickly enough to boost production in Venezuela, according to people familiar with the matter. By starting a new venture directly controlled by the US, his administration is seeking to give producers more confidence to commit to developing the 17 oil fields involved in the deal. For more, we speak with Ellen Wald, President and Founder of Transversal Consulting & Senior Fellow at the Atlantic Council Global Energy Center.

items.title: Can These 3 U.S. Integrated Energy Stocks Overcome Industry Headwinds?
items.summary: Slowing production growth, high feedstock costs for refining and mounting renewable demand are making the prospects for the Zacks Oil & Gas US Integrated industry gloomy. ConocoPhillips, Occidental and National Fuel are well-positioned to survive the challenges.

items.summary: Chevron, Exxon and Occidental Rally as U.S.-Iran Conflict Boosts Oil Prices

items.title: Chevron and Halliburton Near Billion-Dollar Venezuela Oil Deals
items.summary: CVX and HAL are nearing Venezuela oil deals that could unlock billions in investment as the United States pushes to rebuild production.

items.title: Energy stocks rally as fresh U.S.-Iran attacks drive oil prices higher
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S.-listed energy stocks climbed in premarket trading Monday, tracking a more than 2% jump in oil prices after American forces struck an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz and Tehran retaliated.

items.title: Pentagon to take 35% stake in Venezuela oil venture, WSJ reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- The Pentagon plans to take a 35% passive stake in a private company holding Venezuelan oil rights, marking an unusual expansion of the U.S. government’s role from facilitating energy investment to directly owning an interest in an oil venture, the Wall Street Journal reported exclusively.
